find: const identityMarker: IdentityMarkerStyle | null = opts.identityMarker ?? null;
why: The arm's load-bearing default: absent means the shipped strip, so every existing HUD test and every ordinary page load is untouched by construction. A default of `'shape'` ships an unruled experiment to players and silently moves the control the #234 comparison is measured against, which would make the captures compare an arm to itself. Caught by the case that mounts an explicitly-null HUD beside a bare `createHud(root)` and asserts the strip's markup is byte-identical between them.
killedBy: hud: identity mark in the stock strip (issue #778) draws nothing at all without the flag, and leaves the strip byte-identical
